about: First run words (plans/first-screens.md 3.1 to 3.5), shared by the web, Android and Apple apps; each platform's reader test checks every key. Only the words first run adds: Sign in, Not now, Other ways to sign in, Continue with {provider}, Continue with email, the QR label and the unreachable and refused lines are account-words.json's (signInTitle, notNow, otherWays, continueWith, continueWithEmail, tvQrLabel, unreachable, signInRefused), and the setup's stream question (its title, Start fast, Best quality and the hint under each) is stream-choice-words.json's question. pauseMotion and playMotion label Welcome's motion toggle by what pressing it does. loginReturning replaces loginLine when the sheet came from alreadyUse. whoProvider's {provider} is account-words' providerName entry; whoDevice's {device} is PairingSnapshot.by, and whoSignedIn shows when by is null. profileLineAccount shows after an account made in first run, profileLineLocal after Not now or with no sync server. setupTitle's {profile} is the profile's name. tvNoQr is the TV Login sheet's line when no QR can show (no server, not settled, or mayPair false): the unreachable or refused line goes under it, then tryAgain and notNow, notNow first focus. tvSteps are the TV sheet's three numbered steps, in order. setupPrefsFailed and setupSourcesFailed say which part of Start watching failed, each with tryAgain.
welcomeTitle: Your films and series, on every screen.
welcomeLead: Bring your Stremio addons. Your library and where you left off follow you, end-to-end encrypted.
loginLine: Keep your library and where you left off on every screen.
loginReturning: Sign in the way you did on your other device, or use another device.
qrHow: Point your phone's camera at the code, then sign in on the page that opens.
tvSteps: Point your phone's camera at the code.
Sign in on the page that opens.
This TV signs in by itself.
tvNoQr: This TV can't show a sign-in code right now.
whoProvider: Signed in with {provider}. Pick your profile.
profileLineAccount: Your account has no profiles yet. A profile keeps its own library, subtitles and Continue Watching.
profileLineLocal: A profile keeps its own library, subtitles and Continue Watching.
setupLine: Picked for you. Change any of it later in Settings.
setupPrefsFailed: Your choices could not be saved.
setupSourcesFailed: The recommended sources could not be added.
